name: Nishi-Magome
tagline: Shinagawa in 23 minutes and Shibuya in 26 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Toei Asakusa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 34 minutes to Shinjuku, 26 minutes to Shibuya and 23 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 11.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 11.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 8.4 m to 24.2 m, a difference of 15.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 5 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 大森赤十字病院, about 23 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 池上幸仁診療所, about 23 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Asakusa Line.
congestion: Toei Asakusa Line runs at 123% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 本所吾妻橋→浅草, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Magome is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Nishi-Magome is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Nishi-Magome in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Nishi-Magome. To Toranomon, for instance, Magome is 3 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥6,000 more at Magome.

neighbours.lead: Ikegami is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Nishi-Magome is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Nishi-Magome in a straight line. Ikegami has the Tokyu Ikegami Line, a different set from Nishi-Magome. To Roppongi, for instance, Ikegami takes 13 minutes longer. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Nishi-Magome comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 第二京浜 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Asakusa Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
